evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing appeals to security/stability (conservation) and mastery of onboarding steps (competence); the value language is in the universal-completion framing, not merely the topic.
Replacement framing positions the new checklist as supplanting a prior artifact, appealing to keeping what works / stability (conservation) via the 'old' qualifier.
